verdict.rationale: The engine is published on npm (`npm install playcanvas`, version 2.22.2 with about 48k weekly downloads). The official `create-playcanvas` scaffolds Vite + TypeScript projects that use it as an ordinary bundled dependency. Related packages (`@playcanvas/react`, `@playcanvas/web-components`) are also on the registry. missing for 10: no documentation that the engine is tree-shakeable or ships side-effect-free ESM, no explicit import/bundling guidance beyond the scaffold, and no independent hands-on confirmation of bundle-size behavior.

support.subject: As a web developer, the engine installs from a package registry into my existing toolchain — a library I import, bundle, and tree-shake like any dependency
